products.name: Launch Website
products.fit: A clear first website with an organized source-code handoff.

features.title: Understand your business
features.plain: A plan based on what you do, who you serve and what people need to know.
features.explanation: Your website starts with your services, the people you want to reach and the questions they need answered before getting in touch.
features.limits: Approved business facts; original field research is separate.

features.title: Up to 3 purposeful pages
features.plain: Up to 3 pages explaining your business, with a clear list of what each page will cover.
features.explanation: Up to 3 agreed marketing pages. Marketing pages are the pages that introduce your business, explain your services and help visitors take the next step. Examples include Home, About, Services, individual service pages, Projects, FAQs and Contact. Each page has its own web address; several sections on one page still count as one page. An agreed article page also counts toward the limit. Supplied plain policy pages are separate. We agree the page list before booking; additional pages receive a separate quote.
features.limits: Unused page slots do not require extra pages. Agreed article pages count within the page cap; supplied policy pages and ready service connections have separately stated limits.

features.title: Complete website writing
features.plain: All writing and editing for your agreed pages, using facts you approve. No word limit or filler.
features.explanation: Your agreed pages receive useful writing and editing from facts you approve. The explanation follows the customer question, with no word-count ceiling or padding.
features.limits: Original field research, legal drafting and unsupported claims are outside scope.

features.title: Search questions mapped to pages
features.plain: A plan matching customer searches to the pages that answer their questions.
features.explanation: Your website receives a keyword-to-page plan: the search questions each page should answer, grounded in your business discovery and agreed services.
features.limits: No ranking or traffic guarantee.

features.title: Page titles and search descriptions
features.plain: Clear page names and short descriptions that search engines can use to explain each page.
features.explanation: Each agreed page receives a useful title and search description, checked against its purpose so search previews describe the actual content.
features.limits: Search providers control how snippets are ultimately displayed.

features.title: Clear headings and internal links
features.plain: Clear section headings and links that help people move between related pages.
features.explanation: Your pages use meaningful headings and links between related information, helping visitors follow the service explanation and reach a useful next step.
features.limits: For the agreed pages.

features.title: Search access and website map
features.plain: A page list for search engines, plus checks of which pages they may visit. Search inclusion is not guaranteed.
features.explanation: Your website receives preferred-page-address checks, an XML page map, and crawl/indexing settings checked against the launch policy you agree.
features.limits: Preparation does not establish submission, indexing or rankings.

features.title: Accurate search markup
features.plain: Extra page code explains your real business facts to search tools, where useful.
features.explanation: Where appropriate, your website includes structured data: factual information in a format search tools can read, matched to what your pages actually say.
features.limits: Only appropriate, supportable facts; no special search placement guarantee.

features.title: Analytics and Search Console connection
features.plain: Connections to visitor reports and Google’s search reports, with your permission and privacy checks.
features.explanation: Your agreed analytics and Search Console connections are set up with approved account access and reviewed privacy requirements; missing access is recorded clearly.
features.limits: Requires approved access and privacy review; no claim of indexing or measured results without evidence.

features.title: A custom visual direction
features.plain: An original look based on your business, using approved artwork you have permission to use.
features.explanation: Your website’s visual direction is developed around your business and approved identity, with purposeful choices for its layout, imagery and overall presentation.
features.limits: Full identity redesign and original photography are separate.

features.title: Layouts for phones and larger screens
features.plain: Layouts that fit phones, tablets and computers, with checks on smaller screens.
features.explanation: Your website adapts to smaller and larger screens, with mobile treatments and checks that keep the agreed content and important contact path usable.
features.limits: Checks and unavailable evidence are recorded; no field-performance or certification guarantee.

features.title: Purposeful interface animation
features.plain: Small, useful movements, with lighter phone versions and support for people who reduce screen motion.
features.explanation: Your website includes subtle, purposeful interface movement with lightweight mobile and reduced-motion treatment, so the design does not rely on animation alone.
features.limits: A custom animated hero or 3D centerpiece is not included in this tier.

features.title: 1 launch graphic
features.plain: 1 picture for promoting your launch, made from approved brand materials and licensed assets.
features.explanation: Your launch includes 1 graphic made from your approved business identity and licensed assets, giving you ready artwork for the agreed launch use.
features.limits: No new full identity system or original photography implied.

features.title: A practical style sheet
features.plain: A short guide to the colors, fonts and visual style used for your website.
features.explanation: Your brand sheet brings the agreed visual choices together, giving you a reference for the colors, typography and styling used on your website.
features.limits: Launch describes a compact color/type/style sheet; Focused describes a practical brand sheet.

features.title: A browser-tab icon
features.plain: One small brand picture for the browser tab, checked to load on your site.
features.explanation: Your website includes one browser-tab icon made from approved identity or assets, with a check that the file loads correctly on the site.
features.limits: One default icon; extra variants separately scoped.

features.title: A default social-sharing image
features.plain: One default picture for shared links, with the page name and description checked too.
features.explanation: Your website includes one branded default image for shared links, with checks of the image, page title and description metadata used for previews.
features.limits: One default image; additional variants separate. Provider cropping and caching may vary.

features.title: 1 inquiry form
features.plain: 1 contact form with up to 6 questions, one receiving destination and one confirmation message.
features.explanation: Your website includes 1 inquiry form, each with up to six agreed fields, one receiving destination and one confirmation state.
features.limits: Forms collect ordinary business inquiries. Ready service connections have their own stated allowance.

features.title: Spam defense and inquiry checks
features.plain: Basic spam filtering, plus separate checks for saving requests, sending notices and showing confirmation.
features.explanation: Your included forms receive basic spam defense and separate checks for saving the inquiry, sending a notification and showing the expected confirmation.
features.limits: A saved inquiry or accepted notification is not proof of receiving-mailbox delivery; evidence and missing access recorded.

features.title: Editable source code
features.plain: Your website source and content files are included. You or your developer can update the code, check changes and publish.
features.explanation: Your website source and content files are included. You or your developer can update the code, check changes and publish.
features.limits: Your custom website comes with editable source and content files. You or your chosen developer can update the code, check the changes and publish them. We confirm the technology, compatible hosting and who will handle future updates before booking.

features.title: Ready service connections
features.plain: One ready booking or newsletter link or standard embed. You supply the active accounts; external service setup is separate.
features.explanation: One ready booking or newsletter link or standard embed. You supply the active accounts; external service setup is separate.
features.limits: You supply an active, client-owned service account and its ready link or standard embed. We check the agreed website connection and its visible path. Creating or configuring the external booking/newsletter service, writing campaigns, automations, payments or account administration is separate work. If a standard embed is unsuitable, agree a link or a separate scope before booking.

features.title: Confirm hosting and service fit
features.plain: Confirm compatible hosting and ready service connections, including access, privacy, fees and transfer limits.
features.explanation: Confirm compatible hosting and ready service connections, including access, privacy, fees and transfer limits.
features.limits: Your custom website comes with editable source and content files. You or your chosen developer can update the code, check the changes and publish them. We confirm the technology, compatible hosting and who will handle future updates before booking.

features.title: One initial website launch
features.plain: One initial launch on your hosting account. You complete provider identity, billing and account recovery steps.
features.explanation: One initial launch on your hosting account. You complete provider identity, billing and account recovery steps.
features.limits: One initial website launch on a supported client-owned hosting account, agreed domain connection, HTTPS/redirect checks, agreed contact-path configuration and source handoff are included. You complete provider identity, billing and recovery steps and provide delegated access. Ready service connections use active accounts you supply. You own and pay for hosting, your domain and paid tools directly. Our fee covers the agreed setup and work. Monthly studio service is optional.

features.title: Domain connection and secure access
features.plain: Connect your web address and check secure browsing, without changing unrelated email settings.
features.explanation: Your agreed domain connection, HTTPS certificate and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects are set up and checked, while unrelated email domain settings are preserved.
features.limits: Provider dependencies recorded; hosting/domain fees separate.

features.title: Up to ten simple page redirects
features.plain: Up to 10 automatic redirects from old page addresses to new ones, using the address list you supply.
features.explanation: Your website includes up to ten simple one-to-one redirects from the old page addresses you supply, helping visitors reach the agreed new destinations.
features.limits: Supplied URL inventory required; discovery, large migrations and redirect chains separately scoped.

features.title: Your supplied policy pages
features.plain: Your supplied, approved policy pages are added outside the page limit. Legal drafting is not included.
features.explanation: Your approved plain policy text can be published as separate policy pages, without using the marketing-page allowance agreed for your website project.
features.limits: Client-approved supplied text; legal drafting separate.

features.title: A complete website audit
features.plain: Website audit with findings, checks we could not complete and corrections within the agreed work.
features.explanation: Your delivered website is reviewed across all review areas, with findings, evidence, access limits and in-scope corrections; additional opportunities are prioritized before release.
features.limits: Not a specialist certification or promise to repair out-of-scope issues.

features.title: Usability and performance checks
features.plain: Checks of phone layouts, keyboard use, readable colors, forms and speed. Results and missing access are recorded.
features.explanation: Your website receives mobile, keyboard, contrast, form and performance checks, with dated evidence and a clear record of checks that could not be completed.
features.limits: No WCAG certification or field-performance guarantee.

features.title: Two consolidated review rounds
features.plain: Two feedback rounds: one for the design and one for the working website. Our mistakes are corrected separately.
features.explanation: You receive one design review and one review of the working staging site. Each uses one combined feedback list from your named approver.
features.limits: Two across the agreed build; defects corrected separately. New direction/features require a change quote.

features.title: Written project updates
features.plain: Written progress updates, a dated work log, launch checklist and list of your accounts and providers.
features.explanation: Written progress updates, a dated work log, launch checklist and list of your accounts and providers.
features.limits: Your custom website comes with editable source and content files. You or your chosen developer can update the code, check the changes and publish them. We confirm the technology, compatible hosting and who will handle future updates before booking.

features.title: Your accounts and paid work
features.plain: You control the live accounts and own your paid custom work. Licenses and provider export limits are recorded.
features.explanation: You control production accounts from the start and own paid bespoke work and supplied assets, with the rights needed to operate your delivered website recorded.
features.limits: Reusable components/third-party software keep their licenses; provider export limits disclosed; optional studio service not required.

features.title: Your delivery folder
features.plain: A folder or ZIP with paid source, approved assets, build instructions, license notes and dated checks, within 5 business days of paid completion or settled cancellation.
features.explanation: A folder or ZIP with paid source, approved assets, build instructions, license notes and dated checks, within 5 business days of paid completion or settled cancellation.
features.limits: Within five business days of paid completion or reconciled termination, receive the existing paid website source, approved content/assets, dependency and non-secret configuration files, a start-here guide, build/publishing instructions, license/account map, dated checks and known unfinished items in a delivery folder or ZIP. Generated hosting files are included where applicable. Connected services and credentials require their separate account setup or secure transfer; a ZIP does not migrate them automatically. This handoff is separate from the 30-day defect-correction window. Client-controlled accounts remain accessible throughout.

features.title: Written guide and optional call
features.plain: A written handoff guide and one optional call of up to 30 minutes to explain your files and next steps.
features.explanation: A written handoff guide and one optional call of up to 30 minutes to explain your files and next steps.
features.limits: A written handoff guide and client-specific account, build and publishing notes, plus one optional handoff call of up to 30 minutes. No software-operation training course or recording is included. Additional training is separately agreed.

features.title: Thirty-day defect correction
features.plain: For 30 days after launch, corrections cover faults against the agreed work. New requests are separate.
features.explanation: Defects against the accepted website scope are corrected for 30 calendar days after launch, separately from your feedback rounds. New requests receive a separate agreement.
features.limits: New requests and external-provider changes separate; paid files not withheld.

terms.title: Fixed project price and milestones
terms.text: Your fixed studio fee is $1,400 for the listed agreed scope: 50% ($700) scope/booking; 30% ($420) written design acceptance; 20% ($280) written staging acceptance before launch. Later payments require written acceptance; silence does not trigger billing.

terms.title: Your exact agreement
terms.text: Your written agreement identifies page purposes, factual inputs, editing fit, costs, exclusions, actual dates, review windows, one approver and acceptance tests for a dated version. Extra work needs an agreed price before commitment.

terms.title: Feedback and written acceptance
terms.text: The agreed design and staging rounds each use one consolidated list. Normally you have five business days to review unless otherwise agreed. Written acceptance or one combined defect list is required; silence never counts as approval.

terms.title: Production time and review windows
terms.text: Typical website projects use 7–10 business days of production after the agreed start and ready content, access and business facts, plus the agreed client review windows. Larger scopes, extra features or delayed feedback can take longer; your written scope confirms the production, review and launch dates. Dates also depend on selected-tool feasibility and actual capacity. The quote reserves launch checks, source handoff and defect-correction capacity; this is a planning estimate, not a guaranteed turnaround time.

terms.title: Approved facts and supplied content
terms.text: Your copy uses approved facts, with no word quota. Supplied policy pages use your approved text, and media requires appropriate rights. Original field research, legal drafting, unsupported claims and original photography are separate.

terms.title: Source-code editing and ready services
terms.text: Your custom website comes with editable source and content files. You or your chosen developer can update the code, check the changes and publish them. We confirm the technology, compatible hosting and who will handle future updates before booking. You supply an active, client-owned service account and its ready link or standard embed. We check the agreed website connection and its visible path. Creating or configuring the external booking/newsletter service, writing campaigns, automations, payments or account administration is separate work. If a standard embed is unsuitable, agree a link or a separate scope before booking.

terms.title: Form and data limits
terms.text: One contact form, each with up to six agreed fields, one receiving destination and one confirmation state; basic spam defense and save/notification/confirmation checks. Forms collect ordinary business inquiries. Sensitive personal information and file uploads require a separate assessment.

terms.title: Creative quantities and limits
terms.text: Your listed graphic, photo-edit and template quantities are the complete tier allowances. They do not add lower-tier quantities. Photo edits use supplied photos. Full identity redesign, original photography and creative variants beyond the written scope need a separate quote.

terms.title: Launch foundations and later work
terms.text: Your build includes launch SEO foundations and 30 days of correction for faults against the accepted scope. Optional care and search improvements can be agreed for the next stage.

terms.title: What the checks establish
terms.text: The delivered website receives the listed website audit and usability checks, with evidence and unavailable checks recorded. This is not WCAG certification, specialist investigation, guaranteed field performance or proof of indexing/search results. Inquiry saving, notification and mailbox delivery are distinct checks.

terms.title: Provider costs
terms.text: Before booking, itemize the required hosting, domain and form/email provider charges, and any separately requested services. Record the actual plan, billing term, renewal, usage limits, fees and account/recovery owner. Required costs are confirmed before you commit. You own and pay for hosting, your domain and paid tools directly. Our fee covers the agreed setup and work. Monthly studio service is optional.

terms.title: Your account responsibilities
terms.text: One initial website launch on a supported client-owned hosting account, agreed domain connection, HTTPS/redirect checks, agreed contact-path configuration and source handoff are included. You complete provider identity, billing and recovery steps and provide delegated access. Ready service connections use active accounts you supply. You own and pay for hosting, your domain and paid tools directly. Our fee covers the agreed setup and work. Monthly studio service is optional.

terms.title: Paid ownership and license limits
terms.text: You own paid bespoke work and supplied assets. Preexisting reusable components and third-party software retain their licenses; provider export limits and operating rights are disclosed before booking. Keeping your paid work requires no studio subscription, while selected vendor fees still apply.

terms.title: Delivery folder and correction
terms.text: Within five business days of paid completion or reconciled termination, receive the existing paid website source, approved content/assets, dependency and non-secret configuration files, a start-here guide, build/publishing instructions, license/account map, dated checks and known unfinished items in a delivery folder or ZIP. Generated hosting files are included where applicable. Connected services and credentials require their separate account setup or secure transfer; a ZIP does not migrate them automatically. This handoff is separate from the 30-day defect-correction window. Client-controlled accounts remain accessible throughout.

terms.title: Cancellation and late payment
terms.text: Cancellation produces a dated ledger of completed work, approved committed costs and payments for reconciliation under the signed agreement. Paid work and client accounts stay usable; unfinished or unpaid status is identified. New unpaid work may pause after notice, but an unrelated invoice cannot justify disabling paid work or withholding account access.

terms.title: Optional ongoing services
terms.text: Monthly care and search improvements are optional. Your build includes launch foundations and 30-day defect correction. The same work or usable baseline is not charged twice.

terms.title: Work that needs another scope
terms.text: Additional pages, features, creative assets, external service setup and migration are assessed and quoted before work begins. Your proposal names the ready service connections and active accounts you provide. Additional connection or account work needs a separate agreement. Optional ongoing care, content and search improvements have their own agreed scope. Provider subscriptions, domains, usage, taxes and transaction fees are paid directly to the chosen providers.

poster.title: Launch Website
poster.footer: Provider charges, taxes and approved extras are separate. Scope, access and dates are agreed before work. See the website for full terms.

terms.title: Annual billing keeps the same work schedule
terms.text: Annual prepayment covers the same monthly units and delivery sequence; it does not bring twelve months of work forward. Availability requires supported-site fit and actual capacity review, and requesting annual billing does not book work or authorize a charge.

terms.title: Supported websites and a usable baseline
terms.text: Your plan covers approved static sites, supported managed CMS sites and defined workflows after account/access/provider compatibility review. A $399 baseline is separate if needed, including its safe-fix opportunity outside month one. A paid studio build or usable Sprint already supplies it; the same usable baseline is not charged twice.

terms.title: Your monthly work units
terms.text: Your plan includes one related small-change batch and 2 agreed improvement priorities. The listed priority types are alternative uses of the allowance; each includes one refinement and checks. Two priorities are completed sequentially.

terms.title: One queue and separate allowances
terms.text: Your site uses one work queue. A small update batch and a priority are distinct units; the same change cannot count as both. Audit findings can use an agreed priority, while defects caused by the studio do not use paid allowances.

terms.title: Useful work is agreed before each cycle
terms.text: Where your plan includes paid improvement units, five business days before each cycle, useful paid improvement work and ready inputs are confirmed. If none is agreed, the next monthly invoice pauses or the unused prepaid annual cycle is reconciled. Charges without approved useful work receive an unused-work refund or credit, with begun work itemized.

terms.title: Unused capacity and delayed work
terms.text: Unused capacity does not roll over. Accepted work delayed by the studio remains owed instead of expiring with the month. Missing client inputs receive notice and a revised available slot.

terms.title: Agreed work windows
terms.text: Monitoring is automated, not continuous human staffing. Review, contact and work windows follow actual agreed availability. Urgent issues are classified, communicated and routed within that coverage; there is no 24/7 service or guaranteed restoration deadline.

terms.title: Advice stays within the plan
terms.text: Advice uses actual available evidence about messaging, discovery, inquiry quality and the visitor journey. Preparation, discussion, analysis and follow-up share the finite plan. There is no profit, traffic, lead, ranking or financial-consultancy promise.

terms.title: Limits for priority choices
terms.text: Each chosen priority uses its stated scope. A graphic uses an existing brand; an article uses approved facts; profile work needs eligibility/authorized access. Newsletter work uses an existing template, audience and approved account, with no automation, list import or new template system. Email sending needs your explicit approval.

terms.title: Provider bills stay separate
terms.text: You own and pay for hosting, domains and paid tools directly. Actual provider plans, taxes, terms, renewals, seats, usage, overages and support/export owners are identified before commitment; unknown costs remain unknown. Studio fees include agreed work, with no new hosting subsidy, markup, reimbursement or prepaid credit.

terms.title: Monthly cancellation
terms.text: Monthly billing has no minimum term. Your quote gives the exact renewal timestamp/timezone and written cancellation route; cancel before renewal to stop future invoices. Cancellation does not disable an already paid client-owned website.

terms.title: Annual dates and renewal
terms.text: Your quote records all twelve service cycles, timezone and written cancellation route. The term ends after twelve cycles; a reminder comes 30 days beforehand. Another annual payment needs written confirmation, with no automatic charge or retroactive term-price change. Without a new agreement, service ends and paid work/accounts remain yours.

terms.title: Annual cancellation and refunds
terms.text: Cancel at the end of the current cycle. Future whole unused cycles refund at the discounted monthly equivalent; before service starts, the full annual service payment refunds. There is no cancellation penalty, retained processing fee, discount clawback or repricing of completed cycles. Studio-caused current-cycle unearned work and delayed accepted work are reconciled separately.

terms.title: A refund example
terms.text: After four completed cycles, eight future whole unused cycles would refund $6,080.00 at your discounted rate. Current-cycle unearned work and delayed-work reconciliation are separate.

terms.title: Refund timing
terms.text: The agreed refund is initiated within ten business days of effective service end, or cancellation confirmation before work starts, with an itemized settlement. Undisputed unearned amounts are returned within that deadline despite other disputes. Bank/processor posting time is separate.

terms.title: Provider refunds follow provider contracts
terms.text: Vendor bills remain separate from annual studio service. No hosting subsidy is accrued or returned; vendor cancellations and refunds follow each vendor’s own contract, without a studio promise of provider refunds.

terms.title: Build rights and overlap stay protected
terms.text: Monthly or annual service covers agreed care and improvements. The same work, defect correction or usable baseline is never charged twice. Ending care preserves ownership, account access and unfinished work owed under your accepted agreement.

terms.title: Your work and accounts when you leave
terms.text: Paid source/content and client accounts remain yours under disclosed licenses/export limits; direct vendor subscriptions follow your instructions. Unfinished accepted work stays owed. Routine paid-file handoff is included within five business days of relevant paid completion or reconciled termination; new migration is separately quoted. An unrelated invoice cannot disable paid work.

terms.title: What needs separate work
terms.text: Unlimited requests, pages, revisions or application development; new workflows, data models, custom integrations and unsupported platforms; new 3D, identity redesign, original field research and extensive migration are excluded. Legal advice, penetration tests, exhaustive accessibility certification, ineligible profiles, invented reviews and guaranteed verification/search/business/AI-citation results are not included.
